metadata.title: SDBS / NIST Experimental 1H-NMR Reference Chemical Shifts
metadata.primary_source: Spectral Database for Organic Compounds (SDBS), National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST), Japan (https://sdbs.db.aist.go.jp/)
metadata.secondary_source: NIST Chemistry WebBook Standard Reference Database 69
metadata.license_note: Reference spectral peak data transcribed directly from public AIST SDBS 1H-NMR database records for non-commercial scientific verification and benchmarking.
metadata.standard_conditions: AIST standard measurement condition: 30 °C (303.15 K), CDCl3 solvent, TMS internal standard (0.00 ppm)
